info.title: Kore.AgentPlatform
info.description:
Kore.AgentPlatform Resource Provider for managing Kore AI Agent Platform
Organizations and their Workspaces.

Organizations are top-level tracked ARM resources. Each Organization is
provisioned together with a default Workspace. Additional Workspaces are
managed through POST actions on the parent Organization
(`createWorkspace`, `deleteWorkspace`, `restoreWorkspace`).
GET and LIST on workspaces are exposed as a child proxy resource type.

Service-to-service authentication between Liftr and Kore uses federated
Microsoft Entra credentials and is enforced at the runtime layer
(not on the ARM surface).

OrganizationResource.description:
An Organization resource in the Kore.AgentPlatform provider.

Top-level tracked ARM resource. Each Organization is provisioned with a default
Workspace atomically; additional Workspaces are managed via the
`createWorkspace`, `deleteWorkspace`, and `restoreWorkspace` actions defined
below.

OrganizationResourceUpdate.description:
PATCH body for the Organization resource.

Intentionally omits ARM `tags`. Liftr does not propagate Azure resource tags
to the partner (Kore.AgentPlatform); customers can still tag the resource via
the generic `Microsoft.Resources/tags/default` ARM endpoint, but those tags
are not part of this resource provider's contract.

WorkspaceResource.description:
A Workspace resource in the Kore.AgentPlatform provider.

Child proxy resource type under an Organization. Workspaces are not tracked
(no `location`/`tags`). Workspaces do not expose PUT/PATCH/DELETE on the
child URL; create/delete/restore are performed by invoking the corresponding
action on the parent Organization:

- createWorkspace  : POST .../organizations/{org}/createWorkspace
- deleteWorkspace  : POST .../organizations/{org}/deleteWorkspace
- restoreWorkspace : POST .../organizations/{org}/restoreWorkspace

GET and LIST are exposed on the child URL and routed through ARM/RPaaS to the
Liftr resource provider.
